name: PowerTECH Co., Ltd.
summary: PowerTECH Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of specialized equipment for the backend packaging and testing sector of the semiconductor industry in China and internationally. The company offers semiconductor automated testing systems, laser marking equipment, and other mechatronics equipment, as well as after-sales, transistor testing, and labeling services.
